> A cross-origin policy refused a response the browser had already received.

The suffix after the dot names which one. `NotSameOrigin` means a `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy` header refused the embed. `NotSameOriginAfterDefaultedToSameOriginByCoep` means you set `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp`, which flipped the effective CORP default to same-origin, so cross-origin resources now have to opt in.

Quick thread 🧵
> A cross-origin policy refused a response the browser had already received.
The suffix after the dot names which one.
`NotSameOrigin` means a `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy` header refused the embed.

`NotSameOriginAfterDefaultedToSameOriginByCoep` means you set `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp`, which flipped the effective CORP default to same-origin, so cross-origin resources now have to opt in.
